handoff.note: MT-051 is ready for validator review, not officially validated. Prompt-feedback import/rewrite/export panel actions now dispatch backend client request builders when ckc_client is configured, drain backend responses into Argus-visible case/status/readout state, preserve no-backend local preview behavior, and keep validator_verdict PENDING.
implementation_summary: Added typed prompt-feedback backend client rows, cells, parsers, request builders, and dispatch methods for import, case fetch, rewrite, and export.
Changed prompt-feedback panel import/rewrite/export actions to use backend calls when a backend client exists, while leaving the no-backend path explicitly local preview.
Drained backend import/rewrite/export responses into Argus-readable case rows, statuses, rewrite traces, export artifacts, case_id metadata, source metadata, and persistence-source readouts.
Keyed backend case selection and mutation bodies by persisted backend case_id while keeping source_case_id as display/value metadata.
Added request-id plus input-fingerprint stale-response guards for import, rewrite, and export so old backend responses cannot overwrite changed local state.
Updated prompt-feedback manual prose and AgentToolRows so future operators/models see conditional backend/no-backend behavior instead of local-preview-only wording.

Pre-review Peirce finding addressed: stale response handling now checks request id and input fingerprint before applying backend results.
Post-review Newton findings addressed: duplicate POSTs are counted, live import/rewrite/export headers and bodies are asserted, and valid UUID lease IDs are used in tests.
Post-review Descartes findings addressed: pending response fingerprints, backend UUID row selection, and manual AgentToolRows were corrected.

residual_gaps: No official validator verdict yet; validator_verdict remains PENDING.

Roundtrip proof still sets the Model Ops lease thread through the harness helper before driving prompt-feedback UI actions; this proves prompt-feedback backend roundtrip behavior but not the separate Model Ops claim/read path.

Argus values are structured key-value strings rather than JSON envelopes for every prompt-feedback result. They are model-readable and tested, but a future hardening pass could make those values strict JSON envelopes.
